description: Publish to a Facebook Page and its linked Instagram Business account

actions.description: Publish a post to the connected Facebook Page: a feed post, a Reel or a Story. Media is resolved from the Work Item's uploaded assets when no explicit media URL is supplied.

params.format: feed, reel or story (optional; defaults to feed). A single video always goes out as a Reel — Meta no longer accepts a Page video any other way. A story publishes immediately and carries no caption
params.message: Post text (required unless link, media params or work_item_id media is supplied; ignored for a story)
params.link: URL to attach to the post (optional; feed only)
params.image_url: Publicly reachable image URL to attach as a photo post (optional; resolved from the Work Item's assets when omitted)
params.video_url: Publicly reachable video URL (optional; resolved from the Work Item's assets when omitted)
params.scheduled_publish_time: ISO-8601 instant to schedule the post for (optional; immediate when omitted; ignored for a story, which cannot be scheduled)
params.work_item_id: Work Item whose uploaded media assets this post publishes (optional)
params.target_id: Post publish target this invocation fulfils (optional; carried for correlation only)

actions.description: Delete a post from the connected Facebook Page, including one that is still scheduled and has not gone live

params.post_id: Platform id of the post to delete (required)

actions.description: Read a Facebook Page post's publish state — whether a scheduled post has gone live yet — plus its permalink

params.post_id: Platform id of the post to read (required)

actions.description: Publish an image or video to the Instagram Business account linked to the connected Page: a feed post, a Reel or a Story. Creates the media container and publishes it in the same invocation, at fire time.

params.format: feed, reel or story (optional; defaults to feed). A single feed video is already published as a Reel. A story takes exactly one item and carries no caption
params.media_type: IMAGE, VIDEO or REELS (optional; inferred from the resolved media when omitted)
params.image_url: Publicly reachable image URL (optional; resolved from the Work Item's assets when omitted)
params.video_url: Publicly reachable video URL (optional; resolved from the Work Item's assets when omitted)
params.caption: Caption text, including any hashtags (optional; ignored for a story)
params.share_to_feed: Whether a Reel also appears in the feed (optional boolean; Reel/single-video only)
params.collaborators: Up to 3 usernames to tag as collaborators (optional list; Reel/single-video only, ignored on a carousel)
params.alt_text: Accessibility description for a single feed image (optional; single image only)
params.cover_asset_id: Id of one of the Post's own image Assets to use as a Reel's cover (optional; Reel/single-video only)
params.audio_name: Attribution label for the audio used on a Reel (optional; Reel/single-video only)
params.work_item_id: Work Item whose uploaded media assets this post publishes (optional)
params.target_id: Post publish target this invocation fulfils (optional; carried for correlation only)

actions.description: Read the like, comment and share counts of up to 50 Facebook Page posts in one call; an id Graph no longer resolves comes back as unavailable

params.post_ids: Platform ids of the posts to read (required, list, at most 50)

actions.description: Read the like and comment counts of up to 50 Instagram media in one call; an id Graph no longer resolves comes back as unavailable

params.post_ids: Platform ids of the media to read (required, list, at most 50)

ingest.label: Post performance
ingest.description: Views, likes, comments and shares for every post published through this account, read back on a cadence and kept per post
